coverage: Verified official sources on utoronto.ca, uhn.ca, sickkids.ca and official subdomains for: IMS admissions and funding wording; Molecular Genetics deadlines and student-funding page; Medical Biophysics programme overview and stipend table; selected SickKids lab recruitment pages; UHN Princess Margaret cancer-centre research environment; and the SGS university-wide doctoral funding policy. I excluded non-PhD fellowships and clinician-only fellowships from opportunities, except as background where needed for context. I returned only records with official-source support and labeled uncertain/closed status conservatively where no current admissions call or explicit lab opening was verified.
gaps: Not exhaustive across every U of T department, affiliated institute, Princess Margaret/UHN lab, or SickKids lab. I did not verify current LMP department-wide admissions/funding pages in this pass, so no LMP programme record was added despite cancer relevance. I found official cancer-relevant lab pages at SickKids, but many did not provide explicit current graduate openings or funding terms, so several potentially relevant labs were omitted. I also did not verify a current MBP admissions deadline page with explicit 2026-2027 dates from the retrieved evidence, so MBP was kept uncertain rather than open. No official UHN/Princess Margaret page retrieved in this pass gave a current explicit PhD vacancy with funding terms, so UHN contributed mainly programme/lab-fit context rather than standalone PhD openings.
